title: Traveling with a Tight Budget
paragraphs: Wanting to see more of his own country without spending too much money, Aji plans a week-long trip using only public buses and budget guesthouses instead of flights and hotels.
The journey is slower and occasionally uncomfortable, with long waits at bus terminals and simple rooms lacking some conveniences he was used to at home, yet the total cost stays remarkably low.

Along the way, he meets other budget travelers sharing similar routes, and they exchange tips about affordable local food stalls that turn out to be more memorable than any expensive restaurant might have been.
By the end of the week, Aji realizes that traveling with a tight budget forced him to interact more with locals and see places a typical tourist itinerary would have completely skipped.
